title: agent-browser-compatible pire-browser config
description: Agent-browser-compatible config defaults accepted by pire-browser. Unknown keys are allowed for forward compatibility.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema URL or local schema path for editor autocomplete.

profile.description: Default managed Firefox profile name or path-like profile value.

state.description: Default active-origin state file to preload before browser-control commands.

actionPolicy.description: Path to an action policy JSON file.

confirmActions.description: Comma-separated action categories that require confirmation.

confirmInteractive.description: Allow an interactive terminal prompt for confirmation-required actions.

noAutoDialog.description: Disable page-shimmed dialog auto-handling for command requests.

hideScrollbars.description: Hide native scrollbars during screenshot capture. Defaults to true; set false to keep them visible.

allowFileAccess.description: Accept local file URLs for supported local-file workflows.

autoConnect.description: Best-effort auto-connect flag for commands that can target a selected live managed Firefox session.

headed.description: Launch new managed Firefox sessions visibly. This is the default.

headless.description: Launch new managed Firefox sessions headlessly for CI-style runs.

colorScheme.description: Color scheme flag accepted by the managed Firefox session.

proxy.description: Proxy URL for managed Firefox bridge commands, or off/none/direct to disable Firefox proxy settings.

proxyBypass.description: Comma-separated Firefox proxy passthrough/bypass list such as localhost,*.internal.

downloadPath.description: Default Firefox download directory for newly launched managed sessions.

args.description: Comma- or newline-separated Firefox launch arguments for newly launched managed sessions.

userAgent.description: Firefox User-Agent override for newly launched managed sessions.

plugins.description: Configured agent-browser-compatible local plugins. Credential providers declare credential.read; command/custom plugins declare command.run and their custom capability.

name.description: Plugin name used by --credential-provider or plugin run.

command.description: Local executable command. Do not put secrets in command arguments.

args.description: Command arguments for the local plugin executable.

capabilities.description: Plugin capabilities such as credential.read, command.run, or a custom capability like captcha.solve.
